subject.title: fix(signal): expose mention facts in inbound context

question: Should the public inbound context keep `GroupRequireMention` as the canonical require-mention field, or should this PR introduce `RequireMention` as a new alias or replacement?
rationale: This PR expands public prompt/plugin context shape, and current main already exposes the same policy fact as `GroupRequireMention`, so automation should not choose the permanent API name without maintainer intent.

options.title: Keep `GroupRequireMention` Canonical
options.body: Drop the duplicate `RequireMention` field and add only the missing detection, any, effective, and skip facts around the existing policy field.

options.title: Approve A New Alias
options.body: Keep `RequireMention` only with explicit docs and tests explaining the alias or replacement relationship to `GroupRequireMention`.

options.title: Pause API Expansion
options.body: Leave this draft paused until the mention-facts context contract is redesigned with the predecessor stack.

recommendation.title: Keep `GroupRequireMention` Canonical
recommendation.body: Drop the duplicate `RequireMention` field and add only the missing detection, any, effective, and skip facts around the existing policy field.

likelyOwner.reason: Their history is strongest across inbound context, plugin SDK mock, mention policy, and Signal monitor surfaces touched by this decision.
